decision: EdgeDiffusion inference is suitable for a 20 Hz integration attempt; current SmolVLA PyTorch execution is rejected for a 30 Hz direct-control claim.
failure_cases: SmolVLA first action arrives after about 1.19 seconds, so startup has no fresh action.
Steady inference is about 0.837 Hz; buffering cannot create 30 Hz policy freshness.
The rented board exposes no confirmed total-module power rail, so energy per action remains null.
Synthetic observation inputs do not establish task success or robustness to real sensor shift.
policy: Newest completed action is used; action older than two control periods triggers safe fallback.
scope: Offline scheduler replay using measured physical-Orin inference timings; not a simulator task-success run and not a physical-robot closed loop.
